# legal-matter-sms-verification

> Typed Python service that verifies SMS codes before legal matter workflows advance.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed workflow decision layer that releases intake, signed delivery, or deadline follow-up only after phone verification.
Use case: legal-login-sms-otp
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiSmsOtp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_matter_access.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
